available_probes.measures: configured versus actual PPO minibatch and optimizer update counts

context.scope: focused adapter investigation; robot behavior has not been measured

messages.content: Investigate the supplied PPO configuration adapter. Select the registered CPU check if configuration preservation needs verification, or hold if no check is justified. Do not claim that a fault is confirmed before a check result. Use only supplied source and facts. Return one JSON object with exactly action, probe, source_sha256, fact_ids, rationale. action is inspect or hold; probe is P_optimizer_updates_cpu_adapter for inspect and null for hold. Copy source_sha256 exactly. Cite at least one distinct existing fact ID. The proposal grants no execution permission.
